description.en: One a line, pattern first: `how do I reset my password => You can do it yourself at /my/preferences/account.` The pattern is a regular expression and is not case-sensitive. A pattern that will not compile costs you that rule, not the app.
description.zh_CN: 一行一条，先写匹配式：`忘记密码 => 打开 /my/preferences/account 就能自己改。` 匹配式是正则表达式，不区分大小写。写错的匹配式只是这条规则失效，不影响整个应用。
